prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1106; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover, trunk lid and both taillight assemblies show crushing and paint transfer that match the rear-end impact described in the report. The damage pattern is largely consistent with the account given. Two similar charges recorded on the same day are being reviewed before the estimate is finalized. The labor hours listed are reasonable for the repairs needed, including panel replacement, refinishing and reinstalling the rear light units. No prior damage to the vehicle is known from the records available, and the repair plan will proceed once the review is complete.
